Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning patient and staff safety at state hospitals.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to improving safety for patients and staff at statehospitals; and adding a new section to chapter 72.23 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 72.23 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature finds that risk of assault at Washington'sstate hospitals creates a dangerous environment for state hospitalpatients and staff and undermines therapeutic treatment goals. (2) By December 1, 2013, the department shall develop a plan toenhance the safety of state hospital patients and staff from assault.This plan must be shared with the executive and appropriate committeesof the legislature. At a minimum, this plan must include considerationof the following elements: (a) Development of increased security areas at the state hospitalsfor effective monitoring and control of patients who present a highthreat of violence where such patients may be more effectivelymonitored and controlled; (b) Adoption of safety planning procedures following incidents of p. 1 SSB 5122intentional assault which ensure that meaningful and perceptibleconsequences follow from such intentional behavior; (c) Consideration of practices concerning state hospital securitypersonnel, including whether roles or placements of security personnelshould be changed; (d) An assessment of training enhancements that could increasesafety from assault, including exploration of alternate securitymodels; and (e) An estimate of the total cost of assault at the statehospitals, combined with a plan to measure the cost savings realized bydecreasing incidents of assault and capturing savings for investment infurther safety enhancements.
